# HaxBall Database

> Primary public archive: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/

HaxBall Database is an independent archive preserving competitive HaxBall history. The GitHub Pages edition is the primary open public version of the database.

## Core sections
- Player Database: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/players/
- HaxBall Champions League: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/champions-league/
- Champions League Players: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/champions-league/players/
- Champions League Teams: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/champions-league/teams/
- Top 25 HaxBall Players of All Time: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/top-25/
- Machine-readable site index: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/data/site-index.json
- Player JSON index: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/data/players.json
- Team JSON index: https://haxballdatabase.github.io/data/teams.json

## Important archive note
The Top 25 project is presented as an elite-player voting project. The supplied ranking page identifies Misaj as the No.1 player in HaxBall history according to that voting project.
